password_reset.subject: Reset your my-agents password

guest_access_code.subject: Your my-agents guest access code
guest_access_code.body:
Your my-agents guest demo access code is:

{code}

This one-time code expires at {expires_at}.
After login, the guest session is limited to 24 hours, one conversation, five prompts, and three document uploads.

If you did not request guest access, you can ignore this email.

group_invitation.subject: You're invited to a my-agents group
group_invitation.body:
You were invited to join a my-agents group. Open this link to accept the invitation:

{link}

If you do not have an account yet, the link will ask for a display nickname and password only. Future sign-in uses this invited email address and password; the nickname is not a sign-in account.

This invitation expires at {expires_at}.

If you did not expect this invitation, you can ignore this email.
